facts.fact: ESTDEV, the implementing partner, states that more than 270,000 births were registered in two months through Kenya's new digital birth registration solution; the principal secretary says the same system may in future be used for deaths. No dateline in the document, so the published date is used.

ESTDEV states that parents confirm the birth and enter the data while still in the hospital and that it goes directly to the population registry, with the certificate issued the same day or within days; before, births were registered on paper forms. Published date used.

ESTDEV states that the new digital birth registration solution registered more than 270,000 births in its first two months, the first time Kenyan parents could register a birth online. Published date used.

ESTDEV states it funded the development of the e-service under the Team Europe Initiative on human-centric digitalisation in Kenya, with the project activities funded by Germany and the European Union. Published date used.

ESTDEV states the solution was developed by ADM Interactive in collaboration with Kenya's Civil Registration Services and integrated with the country's existing systems, and the principal secretary for Immigration and Citizen Services speaks of it as 'our civil registration system'. Published date used.
